title: [L8] Sanitize user-supplied filenames in Storage module
description:
## Severity: LOW

## Finding
**File:** src/Modules/Storage/Foundry.Storage.Application/Commands/UploadFile/UploadFileHandler.cs:40,55

The original user-supplied file.FileName is stored in StoredFile.FileName (metadata) without sanitization. The actual storage key uses a server-generated GUID, so the filename is only metadata.

However, if the filename is later returned to clients and used in a Content-Disposition header without sanitization, it could cause header injection or UI confusion.

## Fix
Sanitize the stored filename: strip path components, replace or remove special characters, limit length. The actual storage uses GUID keys so this is purely for display/download metadata.

title: [L7] Add architecture test for IgnoreQueryFilters usage
description:
## Severity: LOW

## Finding
3 uses of IgnoreQueryFilters/AllTenants exist — all justified:
- ServiceAccountRepository.cs:29 — API key lookup before tenant context established
- MeteringDbSeeder.cs:69 — Seeding system-level quota definitions  
- QuotaDefinitionRepository.cs:44 — Plan-level default quotas

But there's no automated check that flags new IgnoreQueryFilters usage for review.

## Fix
Add an architecture test (using NetArchTest or similar) that whitelists the known bypasses and fails if any new IgnoreQueryFilters() or AllTenants() calls are added, ensuring they're reviewed for tenant isolation implications.
close_reason: Architecture tests for tenant filtering exist in MultiTenancyArchitectureTests

title: [L6] Have Dapper services inject ITenantContext instead of accepting tenantId parameter
description:
## Severity: LOW

## Finding
**Files:** InvoiceQueryService.cs, InvoiceReportService.cs, PaymentReportService.cs, RevenueReportService.cs

These Dapper services take Guid tenantId as a method parameter rather than reading from ITenantContext. This means the calling code must pass the correct tenant ID — if a caller passes the wrong tenant ID, data leaks across tenants.

Related to M1 (centralized Dapper tenant filtering) but more specific.

## Fix
Change these services to inject ITenantContext and read TenantId from it, removing the tenantId method parameter. This makes tenant isolation automatic rather than caller-dependent.

title: [L5] Consolidate duplicate HasPermissionAttribute definitions
description:

**Files:**
- src/Modules/Identity/Foundry.Identity.Api/Authorization/HasPermissionAttribute.cs
- src/Modules/Identity/Foundry.Identity.Infrastructure/Authorization/HasPermissionAttribute.cs

Two identical HasPermissionAttribute classes exist in different namespaces. Controllers import from Identity.Api.Authorization (e.g., RolesController.cs:2), while the Infrastructure one may be used elsewhere or unused.

## Fix
Consolidate to a single location. If the attribute needs to be in the Api layer (for controller references), remove the Infrastructure copy. If it needs to be in Infrastructure (for the policy provider), move all references there.

title: [L2] Override Meilisearch MasterKey in production config
description:
## Severity: LOW

## Finding
**Files:** src/Foundry.Api/appsettings.json:43-44, appsettings.Development.json:36

MasterKey: 'foundry-dev-key' is in the base appsettings.json (not just Development). Production and Staging configs don't override this value, so they inherit the dev key. If Meilisearch is deployed in production, the master key is well-known.

## Fix
Add "MasterKey": "OVERRIDE_VIA_ENV_VAR" to appsettings.Production.json and appsettings.Staging.json, or add startup validation that the key isn't the default in non-dev environments.
close_reason: Meilisearch configuration no longer exists in any appsettings files - feature was removed

title: [L1] Fix case-sensitive role matching in RolePermissionMapping
description:
## Severity: LOW

## Finding
**File:** src/Modules/Identity/Foundry.Identity.Infrastructure/Authorization/RolePermissionMapping.cs:43-44

Role names are compared case-sensitively: .Where(r => _rolePermissions.ContainsKey(r)). Dictionary keys are lowercase ('admin', 'manager', 'user'). If Keycloak sends 'Admin' (uppercase), the mapping silently fails.

TenantResolutionMiddleware already handles this with StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase (line 78), but RolePermissionMapping does not.

## Fix
Use a case-insensitive dictionary (StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase) or normalize role names to lowercase before lookup.

title: wallow-auth: no UsePathBase equivalent; /client.js is hardcoded
description: Blazor supported UsePathBase for deployment under a non-root path prefix. apps/wallow-auth hardcodes /client.js and other absolute-root paths, so it cannot currently be deployed under a path prefix. Low priority — no current deployment needs this.
design: If ever needed: introduce a configurable base path threaded through server.ts's asset-serving and the client entry script tag, mirroring how vite.config.ts's entryFileNames is currently pinned.
acceptance_criteria: Filed for visibility; no acceptance criteria required unless a deployment need arises — resolve as won't-fix if no fork ever needs a path-prefixed deployment.
notes:
TRIAGE: DEFER. Confirmed hardcoded absolute-root paths: vite.config.ts pins entryFileNames to the literal 'client.js', and routes/__root.tsx's DocumentShell hardcodes <script src="/client.js"> (and '/src/client.tsx' in dev). Blazor's App.razor did support this via <base href="@(...PathBase...)/">, confirming this is a real parity loss, not invented. However the bead's own acceptance criteria already frames this as won't-fix-unless-needed ('no acceptance criteria required unless a deployment need arises'), and team priority guidance explicitly ranks deployment-flexibility items like this below the accessibility/security items in this batch. No current fork deployment needs a path-prefixed mount. Recommend: leave open as tracked, deliberately low-priority follow-up; do not fix as part of the epic.
AUDIT 2026-07-25 (verify-ffpq): STILL_VALID, keep deferred (won't-fix is also defensible — production's documented mitigation is proxy-side prefix stripping, docker-compose.production.yml:10-12; only the API keeps PathBase). CORRECTIONS: (1) stale pointer — the pinned filenames moved from apps/wallow-auth/vite.config.ts to the shared preset packages/web-shell/src/server/vite-presets.ts:52-54; (2) scope is BOTH apps, not just wallow-auth — apps/wallow-web/src/routes/__root.tsx:23,35 has the identical hardcoded /client.js and /client.css pair (wallow-auth __root.tsx:26,38). Live-confirmed: /auth/login and /auth/client.js -> 404 on the standalone host. If ever fixed: thread base path through createClientViteConfig entry/assetFileNames + Vite base, both __root.tsx files, standalone-host.ts static lookup + SSR dispatch, and router basepath. Consider retitling to cover both apps.
SCOUT FILES (paths:lines): apps/wallow-auth/src/routes/__root.tsx:26,38,75-76 — clientEntry='/client.js'(prod)/'/src/client.tsx'(dev), stylesheetHref='/client.css', both hardcoded absolute-root and rendered via <script src> + <DocumentStyles>. apps/wallow-web/src/routes/__root.tsx:23,35,73-74 — identical pattern, same two constants. packages/web-shell/src/server/vite-presets.ts:39-56 (createClientViteConfig) — no Vite 'base' option set (implicit '/'), pins entryFileNames:'client.js', assetFileNames:'[name][extname]'; consumed by both apps' vite.config.ts. packages/web-shell/src/static-assets.ts:70-90 (createStaticAssetReader) — strips only leading slashes then joins straight onto rootDir(dist/client); no prefix-stripping capability. packages/web-shell/src/server/standalone-host.ts:118-183 (createStandaloneHost) — readStaticAsset(pathname) called with the raw request pathname unmodified; non-asset/non-proxy paths fall straight to render(). packages/web-shell/src/server/dev-server.ts:213-233 (createDevServer) — Vite middlewareMode instance mounted at root with no prefix handling before vite.middlewares/SSR fallthrough. apps/wallow-auth/src/router.tsx:33-39 (createRouter/createTanStackRouter) — no 'basepath' option passed (TanStack Router supports one); apps/wallow-web has the analogous router.tsx. Precedent for env-driven per-deployment override: apps/wallow-auth/src/lib/auth-server.ts:95 (process.env.WALLOW_API_INTERNAL_URL) — model to mirror for any BASE_PATH-style env var.
SCOUT ROOT_CAUSE: No base-path/PathBase mechanism exists anywhere in wallow-auth or wallow-web (both apps are byte-identical on this axis, sharing packages/web-shell). Blazor's App.razor used <base href> + UsePathBase to make asset/route resolution relative to a deployment prefix; the TanStack Start port has NO equivalent: (1) Vite client build's 'base' is left at its implicit '/' default and output filenames are pinned literally (client.js/client.css), (2) each app's __root.tsx document shell hardcodes '/client.js' and '/client.css' as absolute-ROOT paths (not relative to any prefix), (3) the standalone host's static-asset reader resolves request pathnames directly against dist/client with zero prefix-stripping, (4) the dev server's Vite middlewareMode instance is likewise mounted at root, (5) each app's TanStack router is constructed with no 'basepath' option so router-internal link generation also assumes root mount. Net effect (live-confirmed in a prior audit noted on this bead): a request to /auth/login or /auth/client.js under a path-prefixed reverse-proxy mount 404s on the standalone host. Production's actual mitigation today is proxy-side prefix STRIPPING (docker-compose.production.yml:10-12) so the app never sees the prefix — only the .NET API keeps a real PathBase.
SCOUT FIX_APPROACH (only if ever undertaken — see TEST_LOCATION caveat below): thread ONE configurable base-path value (mirror the env-var precedent at apps/wallow-auth/src/lib/auth-server.ts:95 process.env.WALLOW_API_INTERNAL_URL) through: (a) createClientViteConfig's Vite 'base' + entryFileNames/assetFileNames (packages/web-shell/src/server/vite-presets.ts), (b) both apps' __root.tsx clientEntry/stylesheetHref constants, (c) createStaticAssetReader's pathname resolution (packages/web-shell/src/static-assets.ts) to strip the prefix before joining onto dist/client — createStandaloneHost itself needs no other change since it already delegates everything non-asset/non-proxy straight to render(), (d) createDevServer's request dispatch (packages/web-shell/src/server/dev-server.ts) to strip the prefix before offering to vite.middlewares/SSR, and (e) each app's router.tsx createTanStackRouter call needs a 'basepath' option set from the same value.
SCOUT TEST_LOCATION / CAVEAT: This bead's OWN acceptance criteria reads 'no acceptance criteria required unless a deployment need arises; resolve as won't-fix if no fork ever needs a path-prefixed deployment,' and it carries two prior triage notes recommending DEFER/won't-fix (2026-07-17 triage, re-audited 2026-07-25 as STILL_VALID/keep-deferred) — flag to the coordinator before running a standard TDD flow on this bead; it may be intentionally not-a-bug-to-fix right now. IF a failing spec is written anyway: the closest existing pattern is apps/wallow-auth/src/router.not-found.test.tsx, which asserts against the rendered SSR document by calling render() from ./ssr directly (new Request(...) -> response.text() -> DOMParser) rather than mounting a live component — same shape applies here (assert the script src / stylesheet href in the rendered document respect a configured base-path env var). IMPORTANT: router.not-found.test.tsx is NOT listed in apps/wallow-auth/vitest.config.ts's nodeTsxSpecs array despite being pure-SSR-render (no live DOM), so today it runs in the slower BROWSER (Chromium) project by default per that config's own doc comment ('every OTHER *.test.tsx mounts a component and belongs in the browser project'). A new base-path SSR spec should be explicitly ADDED to the nodeTsxSpecs array in apps/wallow-auth/vitest.config.ts (and the mirror list in apps/wallow-web/vitest.config.ts if scoped to both apps) so it lands in the node project — it needs no Chromium.
SCOUT TEST_CMD: pnpm --filter @bc-solutions-coder/wallow-auth test  (runs both vitest projects incl. the node project a new SSR spec should join). Scoped to just the node project: pnpm --filter @bc-solutions-coder/wallow-auth exec vitest run --project node. Package names confirmed: @bc-solutions-coder/wallow-auth (apps/wallow-auth/package.json) and @bc-solutions-coder/wallow-web (apps/wallow-web/package.json) if scope expands to both apps per the 2026-07-25 audit note already on this bead.
team-build coordinator decision 2026-07-26: deferred, not implemented. Bead's own acceptance criteria + triage passes (2026-07-17, 2026-07-25) say won't-fix unless a fork needs path-prefixed deployment. Scout findings remain on bead for whoever picks it up.
RESOLVED 2026-07-29: implemented by b343b656 (feat(auth): support serving under a base path for path-hosted deployments) — AUTH_BASE_PATH build-time knob in apps/wallow-auth/src/lib/base-path.ts, threaded through Vite base, router basepath, start.ts, and api-passthrough prefix stripping, with tests (base-path.test.ts, base-path-wiring.test.ts) and a Dockerfile ARG. Documented as the default production topology in docs/operations/deployment.md via 11f49b1f (wallow.dev/auth/* forwards the FULL path; proxy strips nothing). The 2026-07-25 audit's both-apps expansion is moot: the TanStack Start migration (cc8311e3) deleted the web-shell vite-presets/standalone-host and the hardcoded /client.js|/client.css constants, and wallow-web is root-mounted in every documented topology (path-based and subdomain), so it needs no base path per this bead's own won't-fix-unless-needed criteria.

title: Upgrade NSubstitute 5.3.0 to 6.x (nullable annotation churn)
description: NSubstitute 6.0.0 tightened nullable reference annotations on Arg.Any/Arg.Is/Received call sites. Under Directory.Build.props TreatWarningsAsErrors=true + Nullable=enable, bumping to 6.0.0 produces ~762 build errors across test projects (388 CS8625 null-literal-to-non-nullable, 368 CS8602 possible-null-deref, 6 CS8604). NSubstitute 5.3.0 is neither vulnerable nor EOL, so this is deferred from the 2026-07 package-update sweep (Phase 3). Revisit opportunistically when touching the affected test files, or do a dedicated pass. Single change point: Directory.Packages.props NSubstitute version. Verify with dotnet build api/Wallow.slnx then ./scripts/run-tests.sh.

title: SEC2: Create separate Postgres user for Keycloak
description:
## Vulnerability (INFRA-10, LOW)
App and Keycloak share the same Postgres user. Compromised app gives full Keycloak DB access.

## Fix
Create separate Postgres user in init-keycloak-db.sql with access only to keycloak_db. Update Keycloak service in docker-compose to use the new credentials.

## Files: docker/init-keycloak-db.sql, docker/docker-compose.yml, docker/.env

title: SEC2: Use REDISCLI_AUTH env var for Valkey healthcheck
description:
## Vulnerability (INFRA-13, LOW)
docker-compose.yml:55 passes Valkey password as CLI argument, visible via docker inspect.

## Fix
Use REDISCLI_AUTH environment variable instead of -a flag.

## Files: docker/docker-compose.yml

title: SEC2: Pin ClamAV Docker image to specific version
description:
## Vulnerability (INFRA-12, LOW)
docker-compose.yml uses clamav/clamav:latest - unpinned tag creates supply chain risk.

## Fix
Pin to a specific version tag or digest, similar to the Keycloak image.

## Files: docker/docker-compose.yml

title: SEC2: Bind docker-compose dev ports to 127.0.0.1
description:
## Vulnerability (INFRA-08, LOW - dev-only)
Base docker-compose.yml binds all service ports to 0.0.0.0 (all interfaces). Risky on shared networks.

## Fix
Change all port bindings to 127.0.0.1:host:container format (e.g., '127.0.0.1:5432:5432').

## Files: docker/docker-compose.yml

title: SEC2: Document Keycloak dev realm security settings
description:
## Vulnerabilities (INFRA-02/03/04, LOW - dev-only)
Dev realm has verifyEmail=false, registrationAllowed=true, directAccessGrantsEnabled=true. These are appropriate for dev but should be documented as requiring override in production.

## Fix
Add a comment block or companion markdown file documenting which realm settings must be changed for production: verifyEmail->true, registrationAllowed->false, directAccessGrantsEnabled->false.

## Files: docker/keycloak/realm-export.json or new docker/keycloak/PRODUCTION-NOTES.md

title: SEC2: Set Keycloak sslRequired to external in realm export
description:
## Vulnerability (INFRA-01, LOW - dev-only)
docker/keycloak/realm-export.json:177 has sslRequired='none'. While dev-only, the realm export is used as template.

## Fix
Set sslRequired to 'external' (allow HTTP for localhost, require HTTPS for external). Add comment noting this is a dev config.

## Files: docker/keycloak/realm-export.json

title: SEC2: Make TenantContext setters internal
description:
## Vulnerability (NEW-API-9, LOW)
TenantContext.cs:7-10 has public setters on TenantId, TenantName, Region, IsResolved. Any code with concrete TenantContext reference can modify tenant mid-request.

## Fix
Change public setters to internal. Only middleware (in same assembly or via InternalsVisibleTo) should modify tenant context. The ITenantContextSetter interface already provides the correct abstraction.

## Files: src/Shared/Foundry.Shared.Kernel/MultiTenancy/TenantContext.cs

title: SEC2: Add logging to audit interceptor exception catch
description:
## Vulnerability (NEW-API-7, LOW)
AuditInterceptor.cs:64-67 has a bare catch that silently swallows all exceptions during context resolution. Audit entries may be written without attribution.

## Fix
Add ILogger and log a warning when user/tenant context cannot be resolved. This aids forensic investigation.

## Files: src/Shared/Foundry.Shared.Infrastructure.Core/Auditing/AuditInterceptor.cs

title: SEC2: Add SRI hashes to AsyncAPI viewer external scripts
description:
## Vulnerability (NEW-API-5, LOW)
AsyncApiEndpointExtensions.cs:44-49 loads JS/CSS from unpkg.com without Subresource Integrity hashes. Dev-only but developers are high-value targets.

## Fix
Pin to specific versions and add SRI integrity attributes to script and link tags.

## Files: src/Foundry.Api/Extensions/AsyncApiEndpointExtensions.cs

title: SEC2: Fix CachedFeatureFlagService ConcurrentBag memory leak
description:
## Vulnerability (B-7, LOW)
CachedFeatureFlagService.cs:15 uses static ConcurrentDictionary<string, ConcurrentBag<string>>. TrackKey adds to bag on every flag evaluation without dedup. Bags grow unbounded between invalidations.

## Fix
Replace ConcurrentBag<string> with ConcurrentDictionary<string, byte> (as HashSet equivalent) to deduplicate cache keys automatically.

## Files: src/Modules/Configuration/Foundry.Configuration.Infrastructure/Services/CachedFeatureFlagService.cs

title: SEC2: Expand magic byte validation to more content types
description:
## Vulnerability (CS-7, LOW)
UploadFileValidator.cs magic byte validation covers only JPEG, PNG, PDF, GIF, ZIP. Other types (HTML, SVG, executables) pass without content verification.

## Fix
Add magic byte signatures for common dangerous types (HTML, SVG, EXE, DLL) and reject them, or use a library like MimeDetective for comprehensive detection.

## Files: src/Modules/Storage/Foundry.Storage.Application/Commands/UploadFile/UploadFileValidator.cs

title: SEC2: Cap presigned URL expiry at configurable maximum
description:
## Vulnerability (CS-6, LOW)
Presigned URL endpoints accept arbitrary expiryMinutes with no upper bound. Users could request year-long URLs that survive credential revocation.

## Fix
Add max expiry validation (e.g., cap at 60 minutes for downloads, 15 for uploads). Make configurable via appsettings.

## Files: src/Modules/Storage/Foundry.Storage.Api/Controllers/StorageController.cs

title: SEC2: Validate storage path parameter for traversal characters
description:
## Vulnerability (CS-2, LOW)
BuildStorageKey in UploadFileHandler.cs and GetUploadPresignedUrlHandler.cs only trims leading/trailing slashes from user-supplied path. S3 treats ../ literally but LocalStorageProvider could be vulnerable.

## Fix
Reject path segments containing '..' or absolute path characters. Add validation in UploadFileValidator.

## Files: src/Modules/Storage/Foundry.Storage.Application/Commands/UploadFile/UploadFileValidator.cs, UploadFileHandler.cs, GetUploadPresignedUrlHandler.cs

title: SEC2: Filter RolesController to tenant-relevant roles
description:
## Vulnerability (NEW-IDENT-009, LOW)
RolesController.cs:34-48 queries all Keycloak realm roles and returns them regardless of tenant. Exposes role names across tenants.

## Fix
Either use a predefined set of application roles or filter to only roles relevant to the current tenant.

## Files: src/Modules/Identity/Foundry.Identity.Api/Controllers/RolesController.cs

title: SEC2: Restrict ServiceAccountRepository.GetByKeycloakClientIdAsync visibility
description:
## Vulnerability (NEW-IDENT-008, LOW)
ServiceAccountRepository.cs:26-33 uses IgnoreQueryFilters() to bypass tenant scoping. Method is public and could be misused in non-middleware contexts.

## Fix
Make the method internal. Add XML doc explaining why tenant filter is bypassed. Restrict access to middleware assembly only.

## Files: src/Modules/Identity/Foundry.Identity.Infrastructure/Repositories/ServiceAccountRepository.cs

title: SEC2: Return generic error instead of Keycloak error details
description:
## Vulnerability (NEW-IDENT-006, LOW)
AuthController.cs:69-75 passes result.ErrorDescription and result.Error from Keycloak's token response directly to the client. Aids account enumeration.

## Fix
Return generic 'Invalid credentials' message instead of forwarding Keycloak error descriptions. Log the actual error server-side for debugging.

## Files: src/Modules/Identity/Foundry.Identity.Api/Controllers/AuthController.cs

title: SEC2: Redact email PII in auth failure logs
description:
## Vulnerability (NEW-IDENT-005, LOW)
KeycloakTokenService.cs logs email addresses at Warning level on auth failures and Error level on exceptions (lines 170-180). PII in structured logs may violate GDPR/privacy requirements.

## Fix
Hash or redact email in failure/error logs. Log only a correlation ID or first/last characters with asterisks.

## Files: src/Modules/Identity/Foundry.Identity.Infrastructure/Services/KeycloakTokenService.cs

title: SEC2: Fix ServiceAccountTrackingMiddleware Task.Run scope disposal risk
description:
## Vulnerability (NEW-IDENT-003, LOW)
ServiceAccountTrackingMiddleware.cs:36-57 uses Task.Run fire-and-forget with context.RequestServices.CreateAsyncScope(). The request service provider may be disposed when the callback runs.

## Fix
Inject IServiceScopeFactory via constructor instead of using context.RequestServices. Create scope from the factory in the Task.Run callback.

## Files: src/Modules/Identity/Foundry.Identity.Infrastructure/Middleware/ServiceAccountTrackingMiddleware.cs

title: SEC: Fix account enumeration via error messages
description: LOW (Risk 4). Auth error responses forward Keycloak error descriptions which differ for valid vs invalid accounts. FIX: In AuthController, return generic 'Invalid email or password' instead of forwarding Keycloak error.description. File: src/Modules/Identity/Foundry.Identity.Api/Controllers/AuthController.cs
